Name: Island Cellar
Author: bpsys
Description:
Would you like to have a cellar on your island?With this modification you will be able to have an extra cellar, this will be in the island cabin and it is completely free.

Setting:
Edit the file "config.json":

mapsize: Change the size of the cellar, choose any of the following sizes: default, big, excessive or standard
mapclear: Specify if you want to repair the floor of your cellar with: yes or no

Downloads.Description:
Fixed a bug that prevented you from leaving the cellar.
IMPORTANT: If you modify the size of the cellar while in a game, you must exit and enter the cellar so that the size is updated, this is due to Content Patcher that no longer updates at the same spee
